profile.name: Muhammad Alfan Muwaffiqul Ihsan
profile.bio: Information Technology Education student at Universitas Negeri Surabaya with hands-on experience building real-world web applications for government clients. Passionate about systems programming, Linux internals, and backend development. Currently exploring Go and low-level C programming alongside teaching experience that sharpened my ability to break down complex technical concepts for different audiences.

projects.title: AMARTA — Infrastructure Management System
projects.summary: Web-based road and bridge infrastructure management system built for DISKOMINFO Kota Blitar and deployed for government operational use.
details: Developed the complete admin panel and public-facing citizen portal backend.
Implemented interactive geospatial mapping using Leaflet.js with GeoJSON data stored in MongoDB.
Developed OTP verification through WhatsApp API for infrastructure damage reporting.

projects.title: Scriptoria — Point of Sale
projects.summary: Point-of-sale web application for a stationery MSME, with role-based dashboards, QR product management, automated reporting, and receipt printing.
details: Built role-based dashboards for administrators and cashiers.
Implemented QR-code-based product management.
Automated daily and monthly sales reporting.
Developed transaction processing and receipt printing functionality.

projects.title: C Systems Programming Learning
projects.summary: Self-directed study project documenting pointers, memory management, linked lists, function pointers, structures, and computer systems fundamentals.
details: Covered pointers, pointer arithmetic, function pointers, structures, memory management, and linked lists.
Maintained structured technical notes using Markdown.
Focused on low-level programming and computer systems fundamentals.

projects.title: Linux Dotfiles & Hyprland Setup
projects.summary: Personal Linux environment configuration focused on productivity, workflow optimization, and reproducible system setup through Git-based dotfiles.
details: Configured and maintained a customized Hyprland desktop environment.
Managed reproducible system configuration through Git-based dotfiles.

projects.title: Recipe App
projects.summary: Android application for recipe sharing and management with authentication, category-based search, favorites, and a workflow prototyped in Figma.
details: Implemented Firebase Authentication for user registration and login.
Developed category-based recipe search functionality.
Added favorites management features.
Designed the application workflow and UI prototype using Figma before development.
